music.name: Sindustry Sundays: DJ Expo, Jeff Straw
music.why: A weekly no-cover residency that swaps in a different touring guest DJ each week, this week a 27-year Berlin-based selector.
music.summary: Sindustry Sundays is a weekly no-cover disco/deep-house/tech-house night at Butter in SoMa, resident Jeff Straw joined by Berlin-based guest DJ Expo, Sunday August 9, 9pm-2am, 21+.

music.name: ::The Box:: w/ DJs Usual Suspects
music.why: One of the only goth/industrial/darkwave nights on the whole weekend's listing, at a no-cover dive rather than a club.
music.summary: The Box is a free goth, industrial, EBM and darkwave DJ night at The Blue Lagoon in Santa Cruz on Sunday August 9, 9:30pm-1:30am, with DJs Usual Suspects, 21+.

music.name: Coffee & Beats: Cimarron, DJ S2, Good Question, Monet Mike
music.why: A free daytime house set inside a neighborhood coffee shop, no cover and no club required.
music.summary: Lose Yourself hosts Coffee & Beats, a free daytime house-music DJ session at Hedge Coffee in the Mission, Sunday August 9, 11am-5pm, with Cimarron, DJ S2, Good Question and Monet Mike.

music.name: The R&B Brunch
music.why: Second edition in Danville after a packed debut, an afternoon wine-bar sing-along rather than a club night.
music.summary: The R&B Brunch returns to Crush'd Wine Bar in Danville on Sunday, August 9, 12PM-3PM, with nonstop R&B from every era.

music.name: Heaven Knows (Farewell Edition)
music.why: DJ Heartbreak's farewell hometown edition before he relocates — last Heaven Knows night at this room
music.summary: DJ Heartbreak hosts one last Heaven Knows R&B night at Luna Sea Lounge in Walnut Creek before moving away, Saturday August 8.

sports.name: Wednesday Fun Run (Presidio)
sports.address: 610 Old Mason St, San Francisco, CA 94129
sports.why: Free weekly trail run through the Presidio with a built-in post-run hang at the store
sports.summary: San Francisco Road Runners Club's Wednesday Fun Run is a semi-chaotic 5-7 mile trail run through the Presidio at an 8:00-9:30 min/mile pace, meeting inside Sports Basement Presidio.

sports.name: SFRRC Saturday Club Run
sports.why: Recurring 50-75-person club run with pace groups from 7:30 to 11:00 min/mi plus a walk group
sports.summary: San Francisco Road Runners Club's weekly Saturday club run, meeting 8:00am at a rotating SF location, with pace groups and a walk group.

sports.name: Bear Creek Half Marathon, 10K/5K
sports.venue: Bear Creek Staging Area, Briones Regional Park
sports.why: Trail half-marathon/10K/5K options with a virtual remote-runner alternative for those who can't make the start
sports.summary: A trail half-marathon, 10K and 5K starting from the Bear Creek Staging Area of Briones Regional Park, with a virtual Remote Runner option; expected field of 500-1,000.

sports.name: Slow Runners Club — Sunday Run
sports.venue: The Panhandle (Baker & Oak, SE corner near the McKinley statue)
sports.why: All-paces, no-drop run through Golden Gate Park aimed at 10-15 min/mile runners, not a competitive club.
sports.summary: Slow Runners Club meets at the Panhandle's southeast corner (Baker & Oak, near the McKinley statue) at 10am on Sunday August 9 for a free, all-paces group run through Golden Gate Park.

sports.name: Golden Gate Running Club — Sunday Run
sports.why: No-drop with a distance choice (5 or 7 miles) rather than one fixed route/pace.
sports.summary: Golden Gate Running Club's Sunday run is a free, no-drop group run in San Francisco at 10am with a choice of roughly 5 or 7 mile routes.

sports.name: GPC Novice Series Ride #2 — Alameda / Bay Farm Island
sports.why: Built for newer riders — flat ~22-mile route, part of a beginner-focused six-Sunday series, not a fast club ride.
sports.summary: Grizzly Peak Cyclists' Novice Series ride #2 meets at Fruitvale BART at 10am on Sunday August 9 for a free, flat ~22-mile no-drop ride through Alameda and Bay Farm Island.

sports.name: Golden Gate Park Sunday Roller Disco
sports.address: 6th Ave & JFK Dr, Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: A free open-air roller disco with a live mobile DJ and taught choreography, not a rink session.
sports.summary: Skatin' Place hosts its weekly free roller disco at Golden Gate Park's 6th Avenue and Kennedy Drive on Sunday August 9, 1pm-5pm, with a mobile DJ and volunteer-led choreographed skate routines.
